BiblicalUsage: James asks a question with only one honest answer: can a fountain give both salt water and fresh at the same spring. In James 3:12 he uses this word for the salt water, and the point is that a mouth cannot bless God and curse men from the same source.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe my words show which spring I am drawing from, and I want the fresh water to be the one that runs.
